_documentation: Configuration for scripts/sync-bios.py. See docs/bios-setup.md for the step-by-step on creating the Google Form, linking it to a Sheet, and filling in the URLs below. While `csv_url` is empty, the workflow runs but no-ops.
_photo_folder_doc: Maintainer reference only; the sync does NOT read this. Google Forms creates a Drive folder on first photo upload to hold the per-question file responses; the share-with-anyone link below lets the workflow (and humans) browse the folder without auth. The sync itself downloads each photo via the per-file URL that arrives in the CSV. Recorded here so a future maintainer (or the maintainer six months from now) doesn't have to hunt for the folder via My Drive > Join the NetSec network (File responses). See docs/bios-setup.md Step 5 for the share-permission setup.
_columns_doc: Header names exactly as Google Sheets writes them for this form. Timestamp + email columns are localised to the form owner's account language (here: French → Horodateur / Adresse e-mail). If you ever change a question's text in the form, mirror the change here so the sync script keeps matching. The Working-Group question was retired from the form (members were often unsure which WG they belonged to, and a guessed answer was union-merged and sticky): there is deliberately no `wgs` mapping here, so the sync no longer reads any self-declared WG. Working-Group chips are now sourced solely from cost.eu's authoritative Membership table via scripts/sync-cost.py. The CSV may still carry a historical WG column; leaving it unmapped means the sync ignores it.
